Know Your Mind

A MOMENT FOR YOUR MIND

Your questions, answered.

A guide to your check-in, saved reports and privacy.

Is Know Your Mind free?

The check-in and full report preview are currently free. Paid subscriptions are not open yet. Any future paid plan will show its price and terms before checkout.

Do I need an account to start?

No. You can complete the check-in and view your report without signing in. An account is used for optional cloud saving and access from another device.

Can I sign in with Google or email?

Yes. Know Your Mind uses Clerk for Google and email sign-in. Signing in alone does not upload reports stored in your browser.

How many questions are there?

The current check-in has 36 questions across six areas: self-awareness, thinking patterns, emotional regulation, decision-making, relationships and resilience. Answer each question to generate your report.

Is this a mental-health diagnosis or a validated clinical test?

No. This is a self-reflection questionnaire. Its response patterns and prompts are not diagnoses, clinical severity scores or a substitute for professional assessment.

Can I see my reports on a different device?

Yes, for reports completed while signed in or saved to your account. Sign in to the same account and open My reports. Reports saved only in a browser stay on that browser.

Will every new check-in save to my account?

Yes, while signed in. Your unfinished answers sync as you go, and completing a check-in saves a separate report with its date. Start a new test for a new report. Without signing in, progress and reports stay in this browser. Old device reports are not uploaded automatically.

How does the comparison graph work?

Choose a question to see the frequency you selected on each recorded date. You can compare two reports side by side. Only the same questionnaire and question language are compared. A higher line means a more frequent response, not automatically better health.

Do I need to take the check-in every day?

No. Choose a pace that is useful to you. The chart adds a point when you save a check-in; it does not invent scores for the days in between.

Can I delete a report?

Yes. My reports lets you delete an account report or a report on this browser. These are separate copies. PDFs or other downloads remain until you remove them from your device.

Which languages are supported?

The questionnaire offers 20 languages. Report explanations are available in English and Hindi. Where a full report translation is unavailable, the site explains the fallback before you continue.

What data goes to Slack or Google Analytics?

Signup alerts contain selected account details such as name, verified email, sign-in method and signup time. Questionnaire answers and report content are excluded. After you allow analytics, Google Analytics measures public-page visits and Know Your Mind counts daily check-in starts and completions separately. It does not receive your answers, reports, name, email or account ID.

How do I change my analytics choice?

Use Analytics preferences in the footer. Declining analytics does not stop you from using the check-in or saving reports.
